name: Whist
tagline: The classic partnership trick game: the dealer's last card names trumps.
rulesSummary: Four players, partners across, 13 cards each. Win as many tricks as you can for your side.
The dealer's last card is turned face up: its suit is trumps. It stays face up until the dealer plays to the first trick.
The player left of the dealer leads. Follow suit if you can; if not, play anything. The highest trump wins, or else the highest card of the suit led.
The side with more tricks scores 1 point for each trick over six.
Honours (a lobby option): the side dealt all four of A K Q J of trumps scores 4, three of them 2. A side one point short of winning can't score honours.
First side to the target (5 unless changed) wins.
